text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hey. Do you know any popular parasols?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking for something lightweight that 
won't feel heavy even if you hold onto it 
for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask...? Well, the turf gets 
pretty hot in the summer, right? We're 
fine, but Trai—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
............ If you don't know, never 
mind. Later.
